---
title: "Site-wide Setup"
---

Instead of configuring support-this in every page, you can set it up once for a whole website or blog, or for one folder of it. Pages then get the support section with no configuration of their own.

## A whole website or blog

Put the filter and the options in `_quarto.yml`. Every page of the project gets the section.

```yaml
project:
  type: website

filters:
  - support-this

extensions:
  support-this:
    description: "Your support keeps this work going."
    platforms:
      github: username
      ko_fi: username
```

## One folder

To add the section to only some pages, such as the posts of a blog, put the same keys in a `_metadata.yml` file in their folder. Pages in the folder and its subfolders get the section; the rest of the site doesn't.

```yaml
# posts/_metadata.yml
filters:
  - support-this

extensions:
  support-this:
    description: "Your support keeps this work going."
    platforms:
      github: username
      ko_fi: username
```

If `_quarto.yml` also sets support-this options, a folder's `_metadata.yml` adds to them: it can change the `display` for the folder, or add a platform, and keep the rest.

## Live example

This site's `blog/` folder has this `_metadata.yml`:

```yaml
filters:
  - support-this

extensions:
  support-this:
    heading: "Enjoying the Blog?"
    description: "Set once in blog/_metadata.yml."
    platforms:
      github: coatless
      patreon: username
      ko_fi: username
```

Its two pages, [First Post](blog/first-post.qmd) and [Second Post](blog/second-post.qmd), have only a title in their front matter, and both end with the support section.

## Changing one page

- A page's own `extensions: support-this:` options are combined with the shared ones. Options the page sets replace the shared values, and the rest still apply. Platforms combine the same way: the page's platforms are added to the shared ones, and a platform set in both places uses the page's account.
- To leave the section off one page, set the entry to `false`:

  ```yaml
  extensions:
    support-this: false
  ```

  Removing the filter doesn't work there: Quarto combines a page's `filters` with the shared ones.
- A page that also lists `filters: [support-this]` still gets the section only once.
